Wellness Affiliate - Join THE IMANI MVMT Team!

About Us:

We're THE IMANI MVMT, a Trauma-Informed Resiliency Coaching Company with a mission to make wellness accessible to everyone. And guess what? We're on the lookout for enthusiastic affiliates who share our vision and values. That's where you come in!

Your Role: Wellness Affiliate

As a Wellness Affiliate, you'll be an integral part of our impactful mission. Your task? Spread the word about our programs and products, and you'll earn a base 20% commission on every sale made using your unique offer code. The best part? Payouts are bi-weekly! 💸 Our range of products, priced between $50 and $399, provides ample opportunities for you to earn an additional income while recommending resources that aid in healing. Check out our offerings here.

Why Join Us?

  • Be part of a mission to make a genuine difference in wellness globally.
  • Earn a competitive 20% commission on ALL sales connected to your unique offer code
  • Products priced between $50-$399 for an unlimited earning potential
  • Bi-weekly payouts for your hard work!
  • Bonus Incentives: Unlock $500 in additional bonuses through our incentive structure, celebrating your dedication to mental health advocacy.
  • Customizable email/text templates to support you as you support others
  • Qualifying affiliates receive 50% off all programs and products. Apply to learn more!

How to Apply:

Ready to join our mission? Register here to kickstart your journey as a Wellness Affiliate.

Healing isn’t something we were meant to do alone ♥️ Your support in this mission means everything ♥️ #IMANIMVMT #MentalHealthMatters #AffiliateProgram #HealingCollectively

Wishing you continued success on your wellness journey. ✨🥰

With love,

Isabella xx
term_and_condition:
Welcome to THE IMANI MVMT! Thanks for joining our Affiliate program.

These following terms and conditions apply to individuals who are accessing or using the Program both as a merchant (“we” or “merchant”) and an affiliate (“you” or “affiliate”) who refers customers to use product or service from the merchant.

By participating in the Program, Affiliate agrees to use the Program in the manner specified in, and are bound by, these Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree to these Terms and Conditions in their entirety you are not authorized to register as an Affiliate or participate in the Program in any manner.

1. Approve or Reject of the Registration

We reserve the right to approve or reject ANY Affiliate Program Registration in our sole and absolute discretion. You will have no legal recourse against us for the rejection of your Affiliate Program Registration.

2. Affiliate Links and Coupon

Affiliate link is automatically generated, but you can also generate an affiliate link for a specific product or collection. If a person clicks on someone else’s referral link and then later they click on yours, yours is the one that counts.

Affiliate might or might not be assigned to one coupon code with details and usage clarified on Dashboard. If customer both click on the affiliate link and use coupon code, you will not receive a double commission. If you’re not assigned a branded coupon, then you’re not allowed to promote the coupon.

Affiliate may also advertise merchant website on online channels such as Facebook, Instagram,... or offline classified channel ads, magazines, and newspapers.

3. Commissions and payment

Refer any customer to make a purchase on our website, you will get a commission amount which is calculated based on Commission structure. Commission amount is dependent on order value and not including extra fee (tax, shipping cost,...).

For an Affiliate to receive a commission, you need to specify the payment details on Settings. Payment schedule will be notified on Affiliate Guide page.

Payments will only be sent for transactions that have been successfully completed. Use of the Affiliate Program is subject to a fair use policy which gives merchant the right to review each and every referral order. Status of commission if displayed in Commission tab, any paid commission will be listed on Payment tab. Transactions that result in charge backs or refunds will not be paid out.

4. Marketing tool

We may share promotion media such as banner, logo or specific collection promotion to you through Marketing tool tab. You can download the media or get the HTML embed code in order to share on affiliate channels.

5. Network

If Network tab is activated, affiliate can invite others to become their downline affiliate. If any downline affiliate brings order to merchant shop, upline affiliate will also get network commission which depends on merchant settings.

To invite other affiliates into the system, share network link and any other affiliate who click on that link and sign up will become a downline affiliate.

6. Cookie

We use a cookie to track people who have clicked on your link, so they need to be using cookies for us to track them.

If a person doesn't allow cookies or clears their cookies then we can't track them so can't pay earnings on that person's activity.

Cookies day is said on the Affiliate registration form. The tracking day will start from the time a customer clicks on the affiliate’s link or use the coupon. Within the cookie time, every order made by this customer at merchant website will automatically result in commissions to the affiliate (There’s no need for the customer to click on the affiliate link then).

7. Removal from Referral Program

If an affiliate wishes to be removed from the affiliate program, they can do so by contacting: Resilience@imanimvmt.com.

Go forward and refer!

We're very glad you've made it to the end of this important document.

We wish you all the very best. You can always re-visit these Affiliate Program terms and conditions in the future and if you have any questions you can send email to Resilience@imanimvmt.com for support.

Affiliate Marketing Disclaimer:

By participating in THE IMANI MVMT Affiliate Program, you acknowledge and agree to the following terms:

  • Payment Structure:
    • Approved affiliates will receive a fixed 20% commission (to total purchase amount after discount is applied) on all finalized transactions generated through their unique affiliate link.
    • Payouts will be processed on a regular bi-weekly schedule, following the submission of a valid W-9 form.
  • W-9 Form Requirement:
    • To ensure compliance with tax regulations, all affiliates must submit a valid W-9 form before receiving any payouts.
    • Submission of an accurate and up-to-date W-9 form is the responsibility of the affiliate.
  • Payout Process:
    • Affiliates will only receive payouts on transactions that are deemed finalized, taking into consideration that any cancellations, returns, or disputes are not included in the payout process.
    • Payouts will be processed promptly according to the designated bi-weekly payment schedule.
  • Bonus Structure:
    • Affiliates are eligible for a $500 bonus for every $10,000 in total sales generated through their unique affiliate link each month.
  • Discounts for Qualifying Affiliates:
    • Affiliates who consistently bring in $5,000 or more in monthly sales qualify for a 50% discount on all products and programs offered by THE IMANI MVMT. (Discount Code: Affiliate50)
  • Sales Discounts:
    • Affiliates have the opportunity to provide a discount of up to 15% to their audience on products and programs. (Discount Code: Resilience15)
  • Transaction Validation:
    • Finalized transactions are those that have been successfully completed, and payment has been received by THE IMANI MVMT.
    • Affiliates will not be eligible for commission on transactions that are not deemed finalized. This includes any cancellations, returns, or disputes are not included in the payout process.
  • Modification of Terms:
    • THE IMANI MVMT reserves the right to modify the terms of the affiliate program, including payment structure and requirements without notice.
  • Affiliate Responsibilities:
    • Affiliates are responsible for promoting THE IMANI MVMT in a manner that aligns with the brand's values and guidelines.
    • Any violation of ethical standards or engaging in fraudulent activities may result in the termination of the affiliate agreement.
  • Termination of Agreement:
    • THE IMANI MVMT reserves the right to terminate the affiliate agreement for any affiliate found in violation of the terms and conditions.
    • Termination may occur at the discretion of THE IMANI MVMT.

By participating in THE IMANI MVMT Affiliate Program, you confirm that you have read, understood, and agreed to these terms. If you have any questions or concerns, please contact our affiliate support team at Resilience@imanimvmt.com.
